register_online_had_hooks: register online Hadamard pre-forward hooks on down_proj and o_proj layers of a rotated HuggingFace model
apply_exact_had_to_linear: apply Hadamard rotation to a Linear layer weight in-place on the input or output dimension
register_online_had_hooks_grouped: register per-group block-diagonal Hadamard hooks on down_proj and o_proj with a fixed group size
apply_cross_head_had_to_linear: apply a cross-head Hadamard rotation to a Linear layer input side across attention heads
matmul_hadU: compute the butterfly Hadamard transform on a tensor using the get_hadK divisor and recursive butterfly pattern
